Source describes monster growls, grunts, and death sounds made for Summoning Wars. Despite the page title Volume 1, the attached archive and member directory are named Volume 2; this is the exact archive linked by that page, not a substituted pack.

Credits are retained as courtesy. The CC0 declaration applies to these source audio files; unrelated website content and logos are not included in this assertion.
